title: Canonical marketplace source (local schema, Candidate C)
$comment: LOCAL COMPATIBILITY SCHEMA -- NOT AN OFFICIAL HOST SCHEMA. Host behaviour remains authoritative; this schema encodes only the subset of fields agent-harness relies on at M1, so it can catch our own mistakes early. A file passing this schema is not thereby guaranteed to be accepted by the host. This is agent-harness's own host-neutral format, not a host format. It is the generation input for both native catalogs. M1.3 replaced the host-shaped `policy` block with named semantic concepts (DEF-001).
description: Validates marketplace/marketplace.source.json. Under Candidate C this is the only hand-edited catalog file; both native catalogs are generated from it.

marketplace.$comment: Every semantic field either native catalog needs must be present here, or generation would have to invent it.

name.$comment: Feeds both host marketplace names. Kebab-case is Official-Documented on the Claude side and Local-M1-Policy on the OpenAI side; the stricter of the two applies here.

Feeds the shared plugin identity in both catalogs and both manifests, so it carries the strictest applicable rule. Kebab-case is Official-Documented for the Claude marketplace entry name and for both plugin MANIFEST names. For the OpenAI marketplace entry name it is Local-M1-Policy derived from identity parity with the Codex manifest -- see openai-marketplace.schema.json. Corrected in M1.4A.

category.$comment: Free-form organisational string on both hosts. Not an identifier.

installation_availability.$comment: Canonical semantic concept -> OpenAI policy.installation. Named so it cannot be confused with the host output field. Official-Documented values.

authentication_timing.$comment: Canonical concept -> OpenAI policy.authentication. ON_INSTALL is Official-Documented. ON_USE is Host-Observed on codex-cli 0.146.0-alpha.9.2 and version-scoped, not a documented cross-version literal. Candidate C emits ON_INSTALL.

items.$comment: Canonical concepts only. Claude defines no equivalent of the OpenAI policy fields, so the generator emits them to the OpenAI catalog only.
